title: Identify and Update GitHub Icon in Sign-In Page
description: Locate the GitHub social login button in the sign-in page and replace the existing Octocat icon with a new icon from the lucide-react library.
details: Search for the GitHub login button in app/sign-in/page.tsx. Find the icon component (e.g., <Github />) used next to the 'GitHub Token' label. Import the desired new icon from lucide-react (e.g., import { KeyRound } from 'lucide-react'). Replace the old icon with the new one, ensuring the className and styling props are preserved for consistency. Save the changes.
test_strategy: Run the application locally. Navigate to the sign-in page and visually verify that the new icon appears correctly, with proper size, color, and spacing. Confirm that the button still initiates the GitHub OAuth flow as before.

title: Update GitHub Icon in Sign-Up Page (If Present)
description: Check the sign-up page for a GitHub social login button and update the icon to match the sign-in page.
details: Open app/sign-up/page.tsx and search for a GitHub login button. If present, repeat the icon replacement process: import the new icon from lucide-react and swap it in, preserving styling. If the button is a shared component, ensure the change is reflected globally.
test_strategy: Run the application and navigate to the sign-up page. Visually confirm the new icon is displayed with correct styling and that the button's functionality is unaffected.

title: Verify Consistency Across Shared Components (If Applicable)
description: Determine if the GitHub login button is a shared component and ensure the icon change is applied consistently across all instances.
details: Investigate whether the GitHub login button is implemented as a shared component (e.g., in components/ui/). If so, confirm that the icon update propagates to all usages. If not, ensure all relevant pages have been updated individually.
test_strategy: Search the codebase for all instances of the GitHub login button or icon. Manually check each location in the running app to verify the new icon is used everywhere required.

title: Visual and Functional Regression Testing
description: Perform a comprehensive visual and functional check to ensure the new icon renders correctly and does not impact button functionality.
details: After making the icon changes, thoroughly test the sign-in and sign-up flows. Confirm the new icon displays as intended, aligns with the design system, and that the GitHub OAuth process works without errors. Adjust icon styling if necessary to match the UI guidelines.
test_strategy: Manually test both sign-in and sign-up pages in multiple browsers and screen sizes. Confirm the icon's appearance and that clicking the button still triggers the correct authentication flow. No automated tests are required for this cosmetic change.
